FINAL SQL:
SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS winner_name, r.ranking_points
FROM (
    SELECT winner_id
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_winner
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = top_winner.winner_id
JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, ranking_points
    FROM rankings
    WHERE ranking_date = (SELECT MAX(ranking_date) FROM rankings WHERE player_id = top_winner.winner_id)
) AS r ON r.player_id = top_winner.winner_id;
